title: Alien Cathedral Embrace
description: A towering green alien with large purple eyes stands centrally, embracing a woman in a pink studded outfit who kisses its cheek. Another woman in matching pink leather kneels submissively on the stone ground to the left, head bowed. They are positioned before a massive Gothic cathedral with pink and black striped architecture under a purple twilight sky, surrounded by vibrant pink orchids and swirling green vines.
